categories.main_business_segments: Tianqi Lithium Corporation operates primarily in the lithium industry chain, covering the development of hard rock lithium mineral resources, processing and sales of lithium concentrates, and production and sales of lithium chemical products. The company also engages in recycling of industrial solid waste and invests in downstream sectors such as new energy materials, power batteries, solid-state batteries, and new energy vehicles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced mining and processing technologies for hard rock lithium and salt lake brine resources, with vertically integrated operations ensuring low production costs. It operates automated lithium chemical production plants in China and Australia, and invests in R&D focusing on mineral resource utilization, lithium extraction technologies, next-generation lithium materials, battery recycling, and solid-state battery technologies. The company also emphasizes intellectual property management and innovation incubation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tianqi serves a stable and high-quality customer base including global power battery manufacturers, battery material producers, new energy vehicle companies, multinational electronics firms, and glass and ceramic manufacturers. Its products are widely used in electric vehicles, energy storage systems, consumer electronics, drones, glass, ceramics, and aerospace sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has strategic lithium resource and production bases in China (Sichuan, Jiangsu, Chongqing), Australia (Greenbushes mine, Kwinana plant), and Chile (via investment in SQM). It supplies products globally, with major sales in the Chinese mainland and overseas markets including Europe, the United States, and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tianqi Lithium operates across the upstream, midstream, and downstream segments of the lithium supply chain. It controls upstream lithium mining resources (hard rock and salt lake brine), midstream lithium chemical production, and actively invests and cooperates in downstream battery materials and new energy vehicle sectors, leveraging vertical integration for cost and supply advantages.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes consolidating upstream lithium resources, expanding midstream lithium chemical production capacity, and penetrating downstream sectors. R&D priorities cover comprehensive mineral resource utilization, advanced lithium extraction, next-generation lithium battery materials, battery recycling, and solid-state battery technologies. It also emphasizes digital transformation, green smart plants, intelligent mines, and sustainable development with strong ESG integration.
categories.revenue_model: Tianqi generates revenue primarily through the sale of lithium concentrates and lithium chemical products including lithium carbonate, lithium hydroxide, lithium chloride, and lithium metal. Revenue is recognized at a point in time from contracts with customers globally, with a significant portion derived from product sales to battery manufacturers and related industries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tianqi Lithium is a leading international lithium company with a vertically integrated business model and strategic resource holdings. It competes globally with other major lithium producers such as Albemarle and SQM. The company holds significant stakes in SQM and operates the world’s largest and highest-grade spodumene mine at Greenbushes, positioning it as a key player in the lithium supply chain.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of RMB 13.03 billion, a 67.79% decrease from 2023, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 8.73 billion. Total assets were RMB 69.56 billion with net assets of RMB 50.06 billion. The company’s gross profit margin declined to 45.98% from 84.92% in 2023 due to market price declines. It has a production capacity of approximately 91,600 tons per year for lithium chemical products, with plans to expand to 122,600 tons per year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tianqi Lithium emphasizes its vertically integrated supply chain, ensuring 100% self-sufficiency in lithium resources with high-quality, multi-dimensional lithium resource bases. Its Greenbushes mine offers high-grade, low-cost lithium concentrates. The company’s automated production facilities and strong R&D capabilities enable it to provide high-quality, customized lithium products and solutions, supporting sustainable energy transitions globally. Strategic partnerships across the lithium value chain and commitment to ESG and innovation further differentiate its market position.
